description: Read daily Meta metrics beside counted PlainRouter arrivals for mirrored campaigns, ad sets and ads. object_metrics contains account-timezone daily comparisons; unmatched_arrivals is one workspace/window count without unknown IDs. Counts are null when the arrivals store is disabled. Optional change history is retention-clamped.

account_id.description: Advertising account ID available to the authorized workspace.

ad_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad ID.

adset_id.description: Limit metrics to this ad set ID.

campaign_id.description: Limit metrics to this campaign ID.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

include_changes.description: Include object change history within the effective date window.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_inventory_metrics
title: Get Inventory Metrics
